context.hint: Evaluate stored relationships against the authorization model selected for the request.
context.surface: An authorization service stores tuples across model versions and supports permission checks and object listings.
assumptions: A disposable in-memory fixture can store relationships created under different model versions.

review.invariant: Object listings apply the same relationship eligibility rules as permission checks.
review.verification: Assert that the tightened model omits ineligible relationships from listing results and still includes authorized objects.

source_observation.summary: The listing fixture confirmed that the repaired evaluation excluded stale relationships while preserving authorized objects.
